answer: Every identity's seal weight is scaled by its nadir depth, the longest quiet span between two of its attested answers, readable on-ledger from the activity rings like a cedar. A twin spawns at full rate with no quiet period, the shape the chain already flags, so its seals count at a fixed ivory floor, say 25 percent, until it organically survives a quiet span at least the cohort median. A clone farm must keep each twin live, miss real blind six-hour epochs, and wait out its nadir before its seals carry weight, so per-clone cost is live identity time the farm cannot compress.
